tooltips.ctwaClid: WhatsApp-only attribution key: the Click-to-WhatsApp click id (ctwa_clid). Empty for Instagram.
tooltips.igSid: Instagram-only attribution key: the Instagram-scoped sender id (IGSID). Empty for WhatsApp.
tooltips.sourceId: The messaging account id — WABA id for WhatsApp, Instagram business account id for Instagram.
tooltips.wamid: Idempotency / dedup key (one row per key). For real conversions it is the provider message id (WhatsApp wamid / Instagram message id). For ad-arrival rows it is a synthetic key derived from the attribution. Never sent to Meta.
